success_criteria: All package manifests declare the expected target versions from expected_dependency_changes.
npm install succeeds for every module with a package.json.
Admin API and frontend startup commands are bounded and return HTTP status below 500 at the declared health check URLs.
CLI smoke commands run without dependency API exceptions; datastore-empty runs must not be treated as failures unless the command exits nonzero due to upgraded API errors.
Solr config files no longer pin luceneMatchVersion 4.9 and schema.xml no longer uses Trie* field classes.

MongoDB, Express, Socket.IO, Winston/Logstash, Influx, UUID, Sharp, CSV, XMLBuilder, Archiver, Send, Nodemailer and UglifyJS impacted call sites no longer use APIs removed by the target major versions.
Generated Solr module smoke test imports admin/frontend Solr modules and verifies select/update path compatibility.

Generated Solr roundtrip integration test seeds one fixture through the admin Solr write provider, verifies it is returned through admin count and frontend search providers, and removes it in cleanup.

rollback_strategy: Revert the single final execution commit created by the executor.
planning_notes: ImpactReport was treated as authoritative. Targeted range inspection focused on package manifests, app startup entrypoints, MongoDB wrappers, Solr configs/search helpers, logging, metrics, and CLI/module load paths; whole files were not read except via narrow Select-String context, and the large Solr schema/config context was inspected around matched config constructs. Several ImpactReport Solr hits in minified vendor bundles, CSS, SVG, CSV data, .gitnexus/lbug, and UI templates appear to be analyzer false positives or non-actionable generated/static assets; they are not in planned_files unless they also contain direct dependency usage. Startup health URLs are user supplied: admin API http://localhost:8080/ and frontend http://localhost:8082/. No datastore records are assumed; empty MongoDB/Solr results must be acceptable for smoke validation. Because package manifests change and user commands depend on installed packages, npm install setup is required in every module before checks. A bounded scope expansion budget of 3 files is authorized only for files not already in planned_files that fail a bounded startup/CLI check because of a direct call into one of the dependencies listed in expected_dependency_changes for the same major-version bump; it does not authorize unrelated refactors or dependency changes.
plan_summary: Upgrade all package manifests to Stage 1 target versions, migrate high-risk dependency APIs at impacted call sites, modernize Solr config away from 4.9-era compatibility, and validate with dependency install, syntax checks, bounded admin/frontend startup probes, and the user-supplied CLI smoke commands.
